{01 00 00 05 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}...

you want breakfast?{01 00 00 05 00} Well, I
ate breakfast a while ago.
{07 14 00}I finished up my post-meal
{04 18 00}{01 00 00 05 00},
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 04 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Oh{01 07 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00}
Welcome to casa de
{04 01 00}!
{07 00 00}You're still under the
guidance of the {ff 00 00 02}Happy
Room Academy{ff 00 00 00}, right?
{07 19 00}You should{01 00 00 0a 00} really learn the
ins and outs of interior
design, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!{07 00 00}

{07 04 00}Oh, hello,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 1f 00}.
Let me offer this piece of
advice, {04 02 00}.
{07 15 00}When entering the home
of a lady,{01 00 00 0a 00} rather than just
knocking and barging in,
{07 1b 00}it's common courtesy to
offer a proper greeting.{01 00 00 0a 00}
Were you raised in a barn?
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Oi, tere,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 1f 00}.
Las ma annan sulle ühe
nõuande, {04 02 00}.
{07 15 00}Daami koju sisenedes
on viisakas{01 00 00 0a 00} mitte lihtsalt
koputada ja sisse tormata,
{07 1b 00}vaid esitada
korralik tervitus.{01 00 00 0a 00} Kas
sa kasvasid laudas üles?

messages.en:
{07 04 00}Oh, {04 1f 00}?{01 01 00}
{07 16 00}I haven't prepared enough
dinner for you, too.
{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}And{01 00 00 05 00} don't guests normally
bring something for the
hostess? {01 00 00 0a 00}Well?
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Oi, {04 1f 00}?{01 01 00}
{07 16 00}Ma pole sinu jaoks piisavalt
õhtusööki valmistanud.
{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Ja{01 00 00 05 00} kas külalised ei too
tavaliselt perenaisele
midagi? {01 00 00 0a 00}Noh?

messages.en:
{07 04 00}Oh, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 14 00} you're here
so late. Perhaps you have a
{07 0b 00}secret you'd like to share?
{07 14 00}If this is about a crush,{01 00 00 05 00}
I'll listen 'til morning!
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Oi, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 14 00} sa oled siin
nii hilja. Ehk on sul
{07 0b 00}saladus, mida tahad jagada?
{07 14 00}Kui jutt käib armumisest,{01 00 00 05 00}
kuulan ma hommikuni!

{07 04 00}Hei, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 1f 00}!
Imeline ajastus! {07 16 00}Ma nägin {01 00 00 0a 00}
täna ülihirmsat filmi{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 07 00}{01 00 00 14 00}Nüüd on mul judinad
peal, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}. Aiiih!
Ära hiili mulle ligi!
